request.prompt: Create exactly ONE isolated, complete full-body character asset of the adult human Jack, age 24, in her STANDARD ORIGINAL MASS EFFECT 2 outfit. This is a faithful static game-art prototype based on the supplied sources, not a redesign. Source priority: (1) in the FIRST reference image, use ONLY the TWO large final-design figures in the RIGHT-HAND rectangular panel for the complete front/back silhouette, rust-red trousers, pale gray-beige fabric tied around the hips, black segmented shin guards, many horizontal buckled straps, and full heavy flat-soled boots. The three small left-hand concepts are rejected early designs: ignore them entirely. This first image is the official FINAL DESIGN DRAWING in the ME2 Collector's Edition art book, not a final in-game model render; retain its visible construction faithfully without inventing additional seams or hardware. (2) The SECOND reference is an actual ME2 capture controlling the recognizable face, shaved scalp, short standing neck collar, reddish-brown leather harness with exact metal connectors and horizontal chest strap, and visible tattoo arrangement. (3) The THIRD reference is a close-up of her game face and scalp marking, for facial identity only. (4) The FOURTH reference is an original 2011 game capture of the full figure in the prison pod, corroborating the standard outfit's general silhouette and colors only; do not copy the pod or restraints and do not infer extra details from its fog. Keep the game character's lean adult build, stern neutral expression, pale skin, shaved head with the observed dark scalp marking, characteristic gold ear device where visible, intricate black and muted blue/green tattoo coverage as observed on the skin, and original chest harness coverage. Use the supplied game harness construction and coverage exactly; no additional nudity, sexualization, beauty retouch, muscular exaggeration or fashion styling. Standing relaxed slight three-quarter front facing image right, both arms down, hands slightly away from the body, fingers naturally relaxed, feet planted separately. Reproduce the final-design trousers and tied fabric's asymmetry and the tall black buckled boots; no sleeveless black loyalty vest, no AAP outfit, no ME3 instructor outfit, no Blur cinematic redesign. Conservative crisp HD prerendered video-game shading and realistic worn materials, with readable forms but no exaggerated gloss. Exactly one character, entire bald head, both hands, all shin straps and both boot soles inside the canvas, with at least 10 percent completely empty margin on all four sides. Genuine transparent alpha background. No ground, shadow, pedestal, cell, props, weapons, powers, captions, logos, border, reference sheet, multiple views, or other characters. Small textile, buckle and tattoo microdetails remain a prototype interpretation of the supplied final-design drawing and captures, not a claim of pixel-identical game extraction.
